target.title: refactor: consolidate number coercion callers
target.body:
Closes #99667

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw had multiple local implementations and a legacy infra facade for the same finite-number flooring, fallback, and inclusive-bound behavior. Maintaining those parallel paths made equivalent numeric configuration and runtime limits more likely to drift.

## Why This Change Was Made

This migrates exact-contract callers to `@openclaw/normalization-core/number-coercion`, removes the redundant `src/infra/numeric-options.ts` facade and its duplicate tests, and leaves domain-specific parsing and fallback policy with existing owners. The migration spans agents, auto-reply, cron, CLI, MCP, infra, talk, transcripts, and plugin SDK runtime call sites without adding a new API.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Developers now have one canonical numeric coercion contract, fewer internal import paths, and 74 fewer net production lines to maintain.

## Evidence

- Focused post-format validation:
  - `TZ=UTC node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/normalization-core/src/number-coercion.test.ts src/infra/heartbeat-schedule.test.ts src/infra/dedupe.test.ts src/infra/outbound/directory-cache.test.ts src/talk/turn-context-tracker.test.ts src/shared/scoped-expiring-id-cache.test.ts src/mcp/channel-bridge.test.ts src/cli/logs-cli.test.ts src/auto-reply/inbound.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/startup-context.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/commands-session-lifecycle.test.ts src/cron/service/timer.regression.test.ts src/transcripts/store.test.ts src/agents/run-cleanup-timeout.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/limits.test.ts src/agents/sessions/settings-manager.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-fetch.test.ts`
  - Result: 7 Vitest shards passed; 310 tests passed and 2 skipped.
- `git diff --check` passed before commit.
- Node syntax checks passed for every changed TypeScript file before commit.
- Fresh commit-level autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Search proof: no remaining core imports of `src/infra/numeric-options`; the separate `@openclaw/acp-core/numeric-options` owner remains intentional.
- Production LOC: 68 additions, 142 deletions, net -74 lines.
